errorMessage: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading "items")
rootCause: The application or UI components were attempting to access an 'items' property on an AIProvider object or lookup result that only defined 'models', causing a TypeError when reading 'items' from an undefined object or provider structure.
patchDescription: Added the 'items' property alias to AIProvider interface and MODEL_PROVIDERS array objects matching 'models', and added safe optional chaining to model lookup functions.

errorMessage: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading "items")
rootCause: The application encountered a 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading "items")' because a component or helper function attempted to access the 'items' property of an undefined object while rendering or processing data. Upon reviewing src/App.tsx, the structure relies heavily on state initialized via localStorage and async Firestore calls, which can sometimes result in undefined or empty references if initial data structures are missing or malformed.
patchDescription: Added optional chaining (?.) to data access points within the rendering logic and reinforced initialization of critical state objects to ensure the 'items' property (or similar array-like structures) defaults to an empty array [] if the source data is missing, preventing runtime property access errors.
